title: Masked Man and Cosmic Wolf
description: A surreal psychedelic painting featuring an older man wearing a black fedora, glasses, and a white face mask in the foreground. To his right stands a black wolf with glowing yellow eyes. Above them floats a large blue cosmic face surrounded by pink flowers, lightning bolts, and swirling colorful patterns against a dramatic stormy sky with purple mountains.
prompt: Surreal psychedelic artwork showing an older man with white hair, black fedora, glasses and white face mask standing beside a sleek black wolf with glowing yellow eyes. Above them a large circular blue cosmic entity with multiple eyes and an open mouth floats among vibrant pink flowers, lightning bolts, colorful swirling patterns and orbs. Dramatic stormy sky with purple mountains in the background, vibrant neon color palette, intricate details.
